meta.title: Ride and Rail — shared rides to the train
privacy.title: Privacy — Ride and Rail
conduct.title: Code of conduct — Ride and Rail
header.subtitle: Shared rides to the train
banner.app: Demo — a prototype for testing. Drives marked Demo are fictional. Other users see your first name and the initial of your last name. Privacy · Code of conduct
banner.privacy: Demo — a prototype for testing. Back to the app
signin.title: Sign in
signin.hint: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to sign in. No password needed.
signin.demoHint: View the demo as one of its fictional drivers, without an email address. You can look around but not change anything.
signin.sent: A sign-in link is on its way to {email}. Open it within 15 minutes, in this browser or another; it works once. If it doesn't arrive, check your spam folder.
signin.deleted: Your account and your data have been deleted.
profile.title: Welcome to Ride and Rail
profile.hint: One more step. Other users see your first name and the initial of your last name, for example "Marie M.". Your name can't be changed later.
profile.conduct: I have read and accept the code of conduct.
profile.conductChanged: The code of conduct has changed. Please read it and accept it to continue.
profile.needConsent: To use Ride and Rail, confirm that you are 18 or older and accept the code of conduct.
account.title: Your account
account.name: Other users see you as {name}.
account.deleteHint: This deletes your account and all your data at once: drives, searches, ride requests and inbox. Passengers who were told about your upcoming drives hear that they're cancelled. It can't be undone.
account.deleteConfirm: Delete your account and all your data? This can't be undone.
demoView.note: You're viewing the demo as {name}, a fictional driver: you can look around but not change anything. Real passengers' requests aren't shown here.
browse.title: Upcoming rides
browse.limited: Showing the next {count} rides. To find one for your trip, use Find a ride on the Passenger page.
form.pickerHint: Type an address to search, or click "Pick on map" then click a point on the map.
ride.title: Find a ride
ride.radiusHint: Drivers whose route passes through both circles on the map. Wider circles find more rides; you get to the pickup and from the drop-off on foot or by public transport.
ride.matchesHint: Click a match to see its route on the map.
ride.askHint: Nothing that suits you? Ask the drivers who often make this trip. A few of them are told, and your inbox tells you when a drive that fits is posted.
ride.askSent.one: Request sent: {count} driver who has made this trip was told. Your inbox tells you when a drive that fits is posted.
ride.askSent.other: Request sent: {count} drivers who have made this trip were told. Your inbox tells you when a drive that fits is posted.
ride.askSentNone: Request sent. No driver using the app has made this trip recently (demo drivers are fictional and are never asked), but your inbox tells you when a drive that fits is posted.
ride.askSentDemo.one: Demo request: it only reaches fictional demo drivers. {count} was told: {names}. Sign out and continue under that name to see the request arrive.
ride.askSentDemo.other: Demo request: it only reaches fictional demo drivers. {count} were told: {names}. Sign out and continue under one of these names to see the request arrive.
ride.requestsEmpty: No open requests. After a search, you can ask drivers for a ride nobody has posted.
ride.recentEmpty: Your searches will show up here.
ride.recentItem: Searched for {time} · click to search again
ride.needTime: Choose when you want to travel.
ride.noMatches: No drivers found. Try wider circles or more flexibility on the time.
ride.noMatchesInside: No drivers within your circles and time flexibility.
ride.outsideHint: These don't fit everything you selected, but might suit you anyway.
ride.noTransit: No direct public transport option found.
drive.title: Your drives
drive.empty: You have no upcoming drives. Offer one below.
drive.priceExplain: Drivers share their costs, they don't earn from the drive: the price stays below the car's cost shared with your passengers, and below the train fare.
drive.priceNeedPoints: Choose where you're leaving from and where you're going to see the price range.
drive.priceBand: From CHF {min} to CHF {max} for {km} km. Train, 2nd class: CHF {full} (half fare CHF {half}).
drive.priceWarn: Above the half-fare train ticket (CHF {half}). Passengers with a half-fare travelcard may prefer the train.
drive.priceOutOfBand: Choose a price between CHF {min} and CHF {max}.
drive.priceShared: When more passengers join, each pays less: {list}.
inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.empty: Nothing yet. Passengers' ride requests on routes you've driven, and drives posted for your own requests, show up here.
inbox.requestTitleMany: {count} passengers are looking for a ride
inbox.done.mute: You won't hear about this route again.
inbox.noLongerOpen: This request is no longer open.
inbox.driveTitle.one: A drive that fits your request was posted
inbox.driveTitle.other: {count} drives that fit your request were posted
inbox.offerFilled: Your usual drive is filled in below, leaving in time for {name}. Check it and click "Offer drive".
inbox.paused: You didn't answer the last few requests, so we've paused them until {date}.
inbox.notifyRequests: Tell me when a passenger asks for a ride on a route I've driven
inbox.cancelledTitle: A drive that fit your request was cancelled
price.trainHint: Train ticket, 2nd class, full fare, for the same distance
transit.fareApprox: Ticket, 2nd class: about CHF {full} (half fare about CHF {half})
errors.not_your_drive: Only the driver who posted this drive can cancel it.
errors.request_too_soon: A ride request must be at least 1 hour ahead.
errors.request_too_far: A ride request can be at most 14 days ahead.
errors.request_not_found: This ride request no longer exists.
errors.not_your_request: Only the passenger who made this request can cancel it.
errors.price_too_high: This price is above the maximum for this drive.
errors.price_too_low: This price is below the minimum for this drive.
errors.no_distance: The start and the destination are the same place.
errors.profile_incomplete: Please finish setting up your account first.
errors.demo_read_only: You're viewing the demo as a fictional driver: nothing can be changed. Sign in with your email address to post drives and requests.
errors.cross_site_request: This request was refused for security reasons. Reload the page and try again.
errors.email_unavailable: The email couldn't be sent. Please try again later.
errors.too_many_requests: Too many requests from here. Please try again later.
errors.invalid_link: This sign-in link is invalid, has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
errors.consent_required: Confirm that you are 18 or older and accept the code of conduct.
errors.name_required: Enter your first and last name.
errors.name_taken: Something went wrong. Please try again.
email.signIn.subject: Your sign-in link for Ride and Rail
email.signIn.intro: To sign in to Ride and Rail, open the link below within {minutes} minutes. It works only once.
email.signIn.button: Sign in to Ride and Rail
email.signIn.linkHint: If the button doesn't work, copy this address into your browser:
email.signIn.ignore: If you didn't ask for this link, you can ignore this email: nobody can sign in without it.
